title: salvia elongata
intro: Salvia elongata, commonly known as the Blue Sage or Elongated Sage, is a plant species within the sage genus native to Mexico and Central America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to provide various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of anxiety, insomnia, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Salvia elongata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as its sedative and spasmogenic effects. The therapeutic actions of Salvia elongata have been attributed to its ability to modulate the central nervous system, promoting relaxation and reducing stress.
